task: MM-DECISION-1 — Define executable test identity semantics for multimodule builds

currentIdentityModel.publicTestIdentity: logical binary class name + declared method name + optional parameter types
currentIdentityModel.runtimeIdentity: runId + jvmId + JUnit platformUniqueId; projected and grouped into logical TestIdentity before schema-v2 fragment output

MODEL_A_GLOBAL_ONLY.rule: one logical TestIdentity has exactly one execution owner
disadvantages: ordinary duplicated execution cannot be represented

MODEL_B_LOGICAL_PLUS_OWNERSHIP.rule: logical TestIdentity remains primary and maps to one or more execution owners
MODEL_B_LOGICAL_PLUS_OWNERSHIP.safeSelection: route a selected logical test to every owner unless coverage is also owner-scoped
MODEL_B_LOGICAL_PLUS_OWNERSHIP.coverage: logical union loses provenance; owner-scoped coverage turns the model into Model C in substance
MODEL_B_LOGICAL_PLUS_OWNERSHIP.failureBehavior: owner-scoped evidence is required to detect that one owner did not execute
MODEL_B_LOGICAL_PLUS_OWNERSHIP.reason: a merely additive routing extension cannot provide safe owner-scoped coverage and completeness

MODEL_C_EXECUTABLE_IDENTITY.rule: ExecutableTestIdentity is the pair of ExecutionTarget and logical TestIdentity

coverageAnalysis.logicalUnion: T -> {ClassA, ClassB, ClassC}; a ClassC change must execute all owners because edge provenance is lost
coverageAnalysis.executionScoped: A::T -> {ClassA, ClassB}; B::T -> {ClassA, ClassC}; a ClassC change selects only B::T
coverageAnalysis.decision: authoritative coverage is executable-scoped; logical union is derived only

selectionAnalysis.MODEL_A_GLOBAL_ONLY: execute the one proven owner; ambiguity is unsupported
selectionAnalysis.MODEL_B_LOGICAL_PLUS_OWNERSHIP: execute all owners of selected T unless owner-scoped coverage exists
selectionAnalysis.MODEL_C_EXECUTABLE_IDENTITY: return logical identity plus target routing metadata and execute exactly selected targets
selectionAnalysis.maven: group by reactor-relative module and test execution; use module-local Surefire/Failsafe includes and target selection
selectionAnalysis.gradle: group by fully qualified Test task path and apply per-task test filters

shardingAnalysis.MODEL_A_GLOBAL_ONLY: assign logical T once to its sole owner
shardingAnalysis.MODEL_B_LOGICAL_PLUS_OWNERSHIP: logical assignment must keep all owners together; splitting owners requires executable keys
shardingAnalysis.MODEL_C_EXECUTABLE_IDENTITY: assign each target+logical occurrence exactly once; union of shards equals executable inventory

completenessAnalysis.invariant: expected executable occurrences = mapped occurrences union executable-unmapped occurrences union positively proven non-executed occurrences
completenessAnalysis.logicalCounterexample: with expected {A::T, B::T}, report A::T only; logical {T} appears complete while B::T is missing

gradleAnalysis.canonicalTarget: Gradle build path + fully qualified project/Test task path

backwardCompatibility.schemaV2Policy: retain explicit v2 readers; use v2 only when exact-revision adapter analysis proves one owner for every logical identity, otherwise full suite and remap
backwardCompatibility.storage: version negotiation must prevent old consumers from admitting new payloads
backwardCompatibility.jenkins: transport structured executable assignments and enforce version-specific exact equality

productAdoption.manualTargetConfiguration: normally no; adapters derive targets, custom ambiguous executions may require configuration
productAdoption.reporting: logical grouping with target-qualified occurrence rows
productAdoption.mapSize: increases with repeated occurrences and their distinct coverage edges
productAdoption.ordinaryBuildSemantics: preserved by routing to actual targets

scorecard.scale: 1 poor, 5 strong; implementation complexity score 5 means simplest

recommendedModel.mavenTarget: normalized reactor-relative module path + test execution ID; coordinates retained as diagnostics
recommendedModel.gradleTarget: stable Gradle build path + fully qualified Test task path
recommendedModel.stability: deterministic for the frozen revision and effective build; never absolute workspace paths or ephemeral runtime/CI IDs

recommendedInvariants: TestIdentity is logical only and contains no execution target
each runnable target occurrence has exactly one ExecutableTestIdentity
inventory, shards, coverage, evidence, and completeness use executable identity
authoritative coverage does not union across execution targets
selection returns execution-scoped tests and adapters execute their named targets
every expected occurrence is accounted for exactly once and belongs to exactly one shard
unknown or conflicting ownership fails closed in mapping/publication and falls back to full suite in selection
migrationStrategy: add semantic types and canonical target rules
define new versioned inventory/fragment/map/evidence/assignment/selection contracts while retaining v2 readers
propagate trusted target context through collectors
convert exactness, joins, Maven and Gradle routing to executable identity
update Jenkins, CLI, reports, storage negotiation and compatibility gates
publish new artifacts only after the producer-consumer path is end-to-end capable
validate SonarJava and focused Gradle duplicate topologies before rollout
